styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, the `h2` heading above the content (upstream uses h2). Colour `ink`.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: A section heading under the page title, as an `h3` (Pets and Visits on Owner Information, Previous Visits on New Visit). `space-6` above, `space-3` below, colour `ink`.

styles.name: subsection-title
styles.usage: A heading inside a section, as an `h4`: one per pet in the Visits section of Owner Information, naming the pet whose VisitList follows. `space-5` above, `space-2` below, colour `ink`. Sits between `section-title` and `table-head` so the outline reads Visits > pet.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The navbar wordmark beside the logo, colour `on-dark`.

styles.name: nav-item
styles.usage: Navbar links and button labels, UPPERCASE, colour `on-dark`.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Table column headers and DetailList labels, UPPERCASE, colour `ink`. DetailList labels use a 24px line to align with their values.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Table cells, pagination, form labels, input and select text, messages, all running text. Colour `ink`.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Spring PetClinic · a Spring Boot sample application
styles.usage: Footer line and a field's helper line (the "yyyy-mm-dd" hint under a date input), colour `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its nav label; between a label, its input and its field error.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pagination items; space below a `subsection-title` before its VisitList.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding (rows measure 49px with a 24px line); gap between fields in a form, stacked or in a row; indent of a field error after its rule; gap between a section title's action link ("Add New Pet") and the table below it; gap between two links in a DataTable actions cell ("Edit Pet" then "Add Visit").

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; nav item horizontal padding; inset of the select chevron from the right edge.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space between the table and the pagination row; footer vertical padding; space above a `subsection-title` and below a context DetailList before its form. Added to `space-3` it is the right padding of a select, leaving room for the chevron.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between the navbar and the page title; space above a section title.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner: navbar, active nav item, table, pagination, form inputs and buttons. PetClinic is square; it has no other radius.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: The `spring-green` bar across the top of the navbar; the `line-strong` rule on the left of an InlineMessage and of a field error message.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The `line-strong` rule under a table header and above a DetailList; the border of an invalid form input (up from 1px, padding reduced by 1px so nothing moves).

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: `line` row dividers and the footer border; the `line-strong` border round a form input and a button.

tokens.name: navbar-height
tokens.usage: Navbar height below the 4px accent bar; the active item fills it top to bottom.

tokens.name: logo-size
tokens.usage: Rendered size of the heart-and-cross logo in the navbar.

tokens.name: hero-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the homepage photo (`.pc-hero`); it shrinks to the container below that. Keeps the portrait photo from filling the page.

tokens.name: field-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a form input, date input or select from the `sm` breakpoint up, and of a whole stacked form (fields and button); below `sm` both are full width.

tokens.name: detail-label-width
tokens.usage: Width of the DetailList label column from the `md` breakpoint up; below it labels stack above their values.
